beats.name: BK2VI-41a · Geordie comes up the steps
beats.words: …won’t it make Gabriel keckle when Geordie comes pantin’ up the grees with the tombstean balanced on his hump…

beats.name: BK2VI-51a · Renfield eats the fly
beats.words: …he caught it, held it exultantly for a few moments between his finger and thumb, and… put it in his mouth and ate it.

beats.words: Renfield has been very sick and has disgorged a whole lot of feathers… he has eaten his birds…
